Day of Anger

A hard, cold, ruthless killer teaches a young man the rules of a life dedicated to violence and based on the speed of a gun. The young man later denies that lifestyle and the two stalk each other throughout the town in a climactic duel to the death.
The Cop in Blue Jeans
An undercover police officer follows the trail of a series of purse snatchers to track down a crime lord accused of stealing five million dollars
The Deadly Companions
An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it by escorting the funeral procession through dangerous Indian territory.
